title: Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA): Your Questions, Answered
description:
Get the answers you need about housing in the City of Los Angeles. In this informative segment, Marcie Vega, Director of Assisted Housing Programs at the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles (HACLA), answers the frequently asked questions from Angelenos.

From housing vouchers and waitlists to eligibility requirements, applications, and available resources, this episode provides clear, direct information to help residents better understand the housing services and programs available to them.

Learn more at:
https://HACLA.org
https://www.AffordableHousing.com/
833-HACLA - 4 - U or 833-422-5248
Public housing applicants may also email application.help@hacla.org
RentCafe.com

For homeless services:
For the City of Los Angeles: 213-473-3231 or 311
For the County of Los Angeles: 1-800-339-6993 or 211
For the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA): 1-800-548-6047
California's Relay Service: 711 or HUD.gov
